systems.country_label: Caisse d'assurance maladie universelle (CAMU) biometric identification database, shared with the CNSS
systems.platform: Innovatrics ABIS, integrated by Akieni; CAMU tenant on a private cloud
systems.owner: CAMU (Universal Health Insurance Fund), under the Ministry of Social Affairs; vendor Innovatrics
systems.tiers: fingerprint verification online at healthcare facilities (tiers not stated); tens of thousands enrolled against a CAMU target of 3.5 million

note: Vendor case study of a biometric registry of health insurance beneficiaries, each given a unique identifier and verified by fingerprint at the point of care; it identifies the person and holds no clinical record or facility reporting, so it is a client registry (exchange) and gives no fact for hmis or emr.
